catalog_metadata.title: Cryptographic Library Policy & EOL Database
target_frameworks: DISA STIG Application Security and Development V5R1
NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (SI-7, SC-12, SC-13, IA-7)
catalog_metadata.description: Authoritative policy baseline of cryptographic libraries, minimum supported versions, EOL schedules, and FIPS validation baselines for GRC bundle reviews.

openssl.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to supported 3.0.x LTS or 3.2.x+ branch. Ensure FIPS 140 provider is configured if required.
openssl.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

pycrypto.description: PyCrypto has been unmaintained since 2013 and contains unpatched vulnerabilities.
pycrypto.remediation: Migrate all cryptographic operations to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography) or 'pycryptodome'.
pycrypto.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

cryptography.remediation: Ensure version >= 41.0.0 to incorporate latest memory-safety improvements (Rust bindings).
cryptography.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

bouncycastle.remediation: Upgrade org.bouncycastle dependencies to >= 1.70 (or bc-fips 1.0.2+) to mitigate cryptographic side-channels.
bouncycastle.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

crypto-js.description: crypto-js is a pure JavaScript library that lacks constant-time security and hardware acceleration.
crypto-js.remediation: Migrate to native Node.js 'crypto' module or Web Cryptography API (SubtleCrypto).
crypto-js.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

node-forge.remediation: Ensure version >= 1.3.1 to avoid known ASN.1 parser and signature verification bypass vulnerabilities.
node-forge.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

golang-x-crypto.description: Go supplementary crypto packages. Deprecated subpackages (e.g. ripemd160, salsa20) are flagged individually.
golang-x-crypto.remediation: Review specific subpackage usage. Ensure standard crypto/aes and crypto/cipher are preferred.
golang-x-crypto.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
